note: Locked numbers for scripts/gate.ts. `target`/`tol` is a regression band; `max`/`min` is a hard bound. `nfl` is the real-world number the sim is aiming at and is informational only. Tolerances are deliberately wide enough that moving a metric TOWARD its nfl value never fails the gate. WORKERS MUST NOT EDIT THIS FILE. Every `nfl` value must trace to a computation in docs/nfl-reference.md — changing a baseline is a decision, and decisions go to the orchestrator. Re-lock with `npm run gate:lock`.

calibrate.scoreMismatches.note: the box score must equal the scoreboard

statcheck.fieldMismatches.note: season totals must equal the sum of box scores

leverage.wrongSign.note: no attribute may move its metric the wrong way

drift.minPayrollSeasonsUnder55.note: no CPU club parked at replacement level

drift.capBustSeasons.note: no contract over 28% of the cap

verify.checks.note: fast tier runs verify 3; a drop means assertions were deleted, not that code got simpler

calibrate.punts.note: known variance: drives run long, punts run light

calibrate.seasonPfg.note: full played seasons, not synthetic matchups

calibrate.seasonPfgSpread.note: league parity: best minus worst scoring offence

tails.milestonesOff.note: KNOWN-HIGH, target 0. Locked across a 5-seed panel; a single seed reads 17-18, so a 1-seed gate run fails this without a regression having happened.

conditions.byeWinPct.note: BACKWARDS today at 48.8% — task P2.3 target 53-58%

conditions.coldPointsDelta.note: cold must score LESS than a dome

conditions.windPassRatePct.note: wind pushes teams to the run

coherence.outlierExplainedPct.note: outliers must have reasons, not just frequency

coherence.eliteCbShadowDrop.note: a shadowing shutdown corner must cost WR1 real yards

drift.saveGrowthMbPerSeason.note: was +1.07 before the save codec and housekeeping landed; now +0.32

drift.passRecordSeasons.note: P1 today; task P2.2 target is <= 3 of 20

drift.tradesPerSeason.note: KNOWN-OPEN. Real volume is ~90 a year (nfl-reference.md S1.1); this guard used to read nfl:3 with a target of 1.44. Matched-seed 20-season comparison: 1.2 before the pick-swap and draft-weekend work, 7.75 after. The floor was briefly set to 8 off a 12-season run, which is a shorter and more generous window -- my error, and the same mistake this file exists to prevent. 5 is below every measurement taken.

drift.playerWeeksLost.note: rotation player-weeks lost league-wide per season

drift.ovrDrift.note: 20-season ratings inflation, must stay near zero

careers.matureCareers.note: sample-size floor: a harness measuring nothing must fail, not report a flattering zero

careers.starterRateMae.note: mean abs error of the 4+ year starter rate vs PFR 2011-19, all 7 rounds. today 5.54

careers.survivalMae.note: KNOWN-OPEN. same for survival to season index 3. today 8.77, was ~12 when tuned against the fabricated 42.6% figure. rounds 3-6 are still 11-16 points too harsh

careers.careerLenMae.note: KNOWN-OPEN. median career span in seasons. today 1.0; rounds 6-7 are still far too short (median 1 and 0 against a real 4 and 2)

careers.r1ShareMae.note: round 1 positional composition vs 15 real drafts. today 2.83

careers.r1QbSharePct.note: KNOWN-OPEN, locked at today's value so it cannot get worse. Quarterbacks are 10.3% of round 1 in reality, 3.27 a draft, sd 1.44 (nfl-reference.md S2.4). Sim reads 14.1 and 17.7 on two seeds. The first band here was set from one seed and failed on another -- widened to cover both rather than to make it pass.

careers.r1BustPct.note: KNOWN-OPEN. a first rounder who never started half a season in four years. today 28.4; the real never-primary-starter rate is 6.3% and the sim's bar is stricter, but not this much stricter

careers.draftSignal.note: round 1 starter seasons minus round 5-7. if this inverts, every scouting feature above it is decoration. today 3.69

staff.problems.note: the staff allocation harness's own four checks: neutrality, no inflation, concentration works, potential is a wall

staff.overPotential.note: HARD INVARIANT. No player may exceed his potential, ever. The whole argument that development spending cannot manufacture a roster of late-round Pro Bowlers rests on this.

staff.focusOvrGain.note: OVR a named player gains over four seasons against the same player unnamed, same seed. today 4.36. if this reaches zero the feature is decoration

staff.leagueOvrDelta.note: A fully specialised league minus a neutral one. Allocation moves value between clubs, it must not create it. today 0.70 -- rose from 0.11 when the scheme lean reached the play engine, which is expected and is why the bound is 1.2 rather than tight.

staff.sampleSize.note: sample-size floor for the concentration A/B

staff.schemeScoringDelta.note: League scoring with schemes fully funded minus schemes at the floor. The lean redistributes attributes within a player, but the play engine does not weight them the way the rating formula does, so zero-sum on the attribute list is not automatically zero-sum on the scoreboard. today 0.56 pts/team/game.
